name: Godland : The Fire Quest
source:
The world that once survived the apocalypse is now headed for its own destruction.
The Great Empire of Drasko is driven by the desire to dominate!

The people of Gusandar decide to flee to an island, a promise of peace...

Seen as cowards, and traitors, you are only running away from the inevitable, a fire that licks the flesh in its quest for destruction...
Will you manage to save your people, to protect them from the fire?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1428570/]Steam[/url]]
